shortDescription: Britain's EnQuest LSE:ENQ narrowed its annual output forecast towards the lower end on Thursday, blaming a five-week outage at its Magnus field caused by a third-party infrastructure disruption, even as the North Sea-focused oil producer swung back to half-year profit.
